integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically. Computational checks are described only within their tested finite range and are not promoted to a universal certificate.
scientific_limitations: The universal proof uses the standard PL antistar-of-a-vertex fact for combinatorial spheres. The included finite computation is a stress test for k=4 through 8 and is not an infinite proof. Novelty remains subject to the residual risk of unindexed older poset literature.
title: A rank dichotomy for punctured Boolean sphere posets
